summary: Explicit stroma expansion excluding generic normal-epithelium conversion.

rules.claim: Only a Planner-selected Tumor or Other tissue source may become Stroma; Normal epithelium is not a generic source.
rules.required_observation: Compare every changed source ID with the resolved source contract.
exceptions: A dedicated, pathology-reviewed primitive may explicitly target a named epithelial structure.
counterexamples: Changing GLaS Normal epithelium to Stroma under a broad source-label list.

rules.claim: Stroma growth must start from an existing stroma/source interface and pass preservation, area, topology, depth/span, profile, and provenance checks.
rules.required_observation: Run the full deterministic gate set before critic review.
counterexamples: Creating a remote stroma island inside normal epithelium.
